programme.desc: In this captivating urban faith stage play, a woman is married to a pro football player who is suddenly injured. Broken in both body and spirit, he hits rock bottom, but his nurse tries to bring him back to the man he was.

programme.title: Kevin Hart: Standing Tall
programme.desc: Laughter is the best medicine. Just ask Kevin Hart. Comedy would rule as antidote to a troubled childhood. Hart's work ethic has no limits with 8 comedy specials, 54 films, 90 TV shows and a global media company.

programme.title: Pastor Wants a Wife - Episode 4
programme.desc: On the fourth episode of Pastor Wants a Wife, the two pastors are taking the ladies out for an adventure that is sure to get their adrenaline pumping.

programme.title: Pastor Wants a Wife - Episode 5
programme.desc: On the fifth episode of Pastor Wants a Wife, both pastors are getting the chance to have one on ones with the ladies to get to know them better.

programme.title: Serial Griller
programme.desc: Host Matt Moore brings East and West together over charcoal on the Ammo Grill. Inspired by his travels to Japan and the renowned Hikiniku To Come experience, Matt serves up juicy Wagyu Hamburger Steaks alongside a lineup of crowd-pleasing favorites. The menu includes Chili Cheese Dawgs, Salmon Kabobs, and Bacon-Bratwurst Fried Rice, each showcasing bold flavors and live-fire cooking techniques.

programme.title: Serial Griller
programme.desc: Matt Moore fires up his Hasty Bake grill outside his airplane hangar, surrounded by his Piper Cherokee and vintage military aircraft, for an Americana-inspired feast cooked over live fire. Drawing from his Lebanese and Syrian heritage, Matt starts with grilled beef kefta pitas before serving a smoky grilled Caesar salad and juicy grilled chicken thighs topped with vibrant salsa verde.

programme.title: Serial Griller
programme.desc: Matt Moore showcases the versatility and convenience of gas grilling on the Napoleon Rogue Pro-S in an all-day celebration of outdoor cooking. The menu begins with family-favorite griddled breakfast smashburgers before moving to a grilled greens salad and grilled shrimp tostadas. Then, a Greek-inspired rotisserie beer can chicken with drip potatoes delivers a flavorful one-pan feast.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue
programme.desc: Argentina. The very name summons visions of rustic gaucho asados and sophisticated grill restaurants. In this show, you'll learn to prepare it from a genuine asador, Argentinean grill master. From a whole wood-grilled rib roast. To a surprising "pizza" made with a flank steak "crust." With two classic Argentinean sauces. Plus something unexpected: an Argentinean meatless mixed grill.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue - Argentine Fire

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue
programme.desc: Brisket-a word that makes mouths water-is the heart of Texas barbecue and the base for Irish corned beef, Jewish pastrami, and Vietnamese pho. From Franklin Barbecue in Austin to NYC's Katz's Deli, experience brisket ramen blending Texas and Tokyo and Korean BBQ that grills brisket in under a minute.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue - Obsessed with Brisket

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue
programme.desc: This show gives grilled and smoked vegetables their due. We start with hot stuff from India: a spectacular Tandoori Cauliflower with Coriander Mint Chutney. From the West Indies comes a squash gratin fired with habanero chiles and perfumed with wood smoke. Not to leave our carnivorous friends out, Mexican-American chef Johnny Hernandez cooks Borrego, Mexican pit-roasted lamb.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue - Planet Barbecue

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue
programme.desc: The U.S. is often described as a global melting pot. We focus on three grilled dishes with international roots. Shrimp cocktail gets the East-West treatment with Thai spices and smoked jalapeños. Chipotle Ribs with chocolate and Drunken Salsa spiked with tequila and roasted chiles. Dessert sounds an equally unexpected note: a luscious Planet Barbecue "Banana" Split made with grilled plantains.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue - Global Melting Pot

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue
programme.desc: The Gulf Coast, stretching from the Florida Keys to Mexico's Yucatán, is a haven for vibrant seafood and bold grilling. From Grilled Oysters with Charred Corn Salsa to a Gulf Coast Shrimp Boil, and Alejandro Gutierrez's Grilled Snapper "Zarandeado," this show serves up the region's finest flavors-fishing for compliments one grill at a time.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue - Gulf Coast Grill

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue
programme.desc: In this episode, we'll travel the BBQ trail from Venezuela to Peru, starting with a Venezuelan specialty-Asopao (seafood rice), reimagined here on the grill by Caracas-born chef Geronimo Lopez. And then a twist on two Peruvian delicacies-Tuna Anticuchos (kebabs) and Smoke-Roasted Peruvian Potato Salad.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue - From Caracas to Lima

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue
programme.desc: Brazilians are world masters at the art of the rotisserie. In this show, learn to cook beef, chickenand pork with the proverbial turn. We start with Brazil's celebrated Picanha (fat cap sirloin)-served with farofa and Country-Style Salsa. Next, Brazilian Pork Loin grilled with Bacon and Prunes, and finally, Rio Chicken Rollatini. So put on some samba music and get ready to rock the grill.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue - The Brazilian Grill

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue
programme.desc: The Caribbean occupies a special place in the annals of barbecue. Taino Indian barbacoa-seafood and meats smoke-roasted on a wooden platform that gave us the word "barbecue." The Caribbean remains a hotbed of barbecue delights; Jamaican Jerk Chicken, Trinidadian grilled vegetable dip called Choka and Shrimp Boka Dushi-a spicy Dutch West Indian kebab whose name literally means "happy mouth."
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue - Fire and Spice

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: The CentralTirgus is the biggest covered city food market in Europe. Just aside the Art Nouveau Old Town, we find century-old rye-bread making, grilled lampreys, soviet milk sausages, and hemp butter. Here the best of Latvian traditions are pushed fast-forward into the digital era by young and curious chefs, bloggers, and pop-up restaurants.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Riga

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: The old ladies selling their baskets full of vegetables and cheese on the Dolac market in Zagreb bring us back in time. At the market, we go from the breathtaking Mediterranean islands to the Austrian Alps, from freshly caught hake and simple Baltic snacks to internationally awarded cheese and a unique Turkey breed.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Zagreb

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: At the Mercato Centrale in San Lorenzo, one can taste the best food treasures Tuscany has on offer: from the olive oil of the Fiesole hills to the onions of the medieval borough of Certaldo and up to the Natural Reserve of San Marcello with its Tuscan cured meats. Here the simple and genuine tastes are king.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Firenze

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: The Viktualienmarkt developed from an original farmers' market to a popular market for gourmets. The market also hosts a number of traditional and folkloric events. But the center of the social life of the city is the world-famous Biergarten - here the seven historical breweries of the city pour the finest beers of the world.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Munich

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: Placed in the middle of Palermo's ancient streets, it is almost difficult to walk. All around there is a swarm of colors and perfumes. There is everything the Mediterranean island, so rich in agricultural traditions, has to offer. Street food here is a must, including dozens of roasted, salted, pickled, and fried specialties one can count on.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Palermo

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: Ireland's third-largest city has one of Northern Europe's market gems: The English Market. It supplies high-quality food to affluent English families unlike the Irish market, which no longer exists. The best Irish produce today remains on the island and can be found here.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Cork

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: The Kapani market is situated just behind the Aristotelous square of the city of Thessaloniki, facing the Aegean Sea. Exploring this market is exploring the city and its history: a tasteful mix of Sephardic, Balkan, Turkish, and Greek delights. All can be found in the intricate streets of the market or tasted at the many cafés and tavernas operating there daily.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Thessaloniki

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max explores medieval English taverns, inns, and alehouses, each serving different roles and social classes. Taverns sold wine, inns provided lodging, and alehouses were private homes selling ale. The episode covers wine quality control, bread and ale laws, and their reputations for gambling and excess. He recreates bokenade, a beef pottage with saffron, cloves, and verjuice.
programme.sub-title: Tasting History with Max Miller - What it was like to visit a Medieval Tavern

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max explores the Old West saloon as a social hub for food and drink. He covers its evolving design, popular beverages like whiskey, beer, champagne, and cocktails, gambling games such as poker, and the famous "free lunch" tradition. The episode highlights regional foods, oysters' popularity, and recreates an 1886 pork and beans recipe from *Cooking for Profit*.
programme.sub-title: Tasting History with Max Miller - What Food was Served at Wild West Saloons?

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max explores WWII home front rationing in the U.S., from 1942 sugar limits to the red and blue point system for meat, dairy, and canned goods. He covers price controls, Victory Gardens, labor shortages, internment camps, and black-market "meatleggers." He also recreates Betty Crocker's "emergency steak," a budget-friendly mix of ground beef, cereal, and milk.
programme.sub-title: Tasting History with Max Miller - Cooking on the American Home Front During WWII

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max explores Titanic's luxurious first class, from modest suites to lavish parlor suites with private promenades. He covers dining in the saloon and Ritz, daily meals, amenities like the gym and Turkish bath, and the 10+ course final dinner. Using survivor accounts, he recreates the famous peaches in Chartreuse jelly dessert from April 14, 1912.
programme.sub-title: Tasting History with Max Miller - Dining First Class on the RMS Titanic

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max explores Titanic's first class breakfast from April 11, 1912, featuring over a dozen dishes by Escoffier. He recreates baked apples, smoked salmon coronets, shirred eggs, and buckwheat cakes with blackcurrant conserve. The episode highlights dining venues, passenger pets, and the tragic story of honeymooners Victor and Maria Josefa Peñasco.
programme.sub-title: Tasting History with Max Miller - First Class Breakfast on the RMS Titanic

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max explores the 4-6 month, 2,200-mile Oregon Trail journey (1846-1869), covering provisions like flour, bacon, and hardtack, cooking over buffalo chips, and staple meals like Johnny cakes. He discusses hunting, trading with Native Americans, celebrations, and hardships, including spoiled food, salt-rising bread, pies, and pioneers leaving possessions at Fort Laramie.
programme.sub-title: Tasting History with Max Miller - What Pioneers ate on the Oregon Trail

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max recreates Ötzi the Iceman's last meal (c. 3,359-3,105BC), discovered in 1991. He covers Ötzi's clothing, tools, health (tattoos, heart disease, parasites), and likely murder by arrow. Using stomach contents-smoked ibex, charred red deer, and einkorn pancake with fiddle ferns-Max cooks over an open fire to mimic Neolithic methods.
programme.sub-title: Tasting History with Max Miller - Recreating the Last Meal of Ötzi the Iceman

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max traces airline food from 1919's first commercial meal to aviation's Golden Age (1950s-70s). He covers flight kitchens, cold-to-hot meal evolution, themed flights, flight attendant hiring, the 1958 Great Sandwich War, and 1978 deregulation. Max recreates a 1954 United Airlines meal of pot roast, vegetables, Delmonico potatoes, and marshmallow-apple salad.
programme.sub-title: Tasting History with Max Miller - Airline Food During the Golden Age of Air Travel

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max recreates Medieval Irish corned beef and cabbage from *The Vision of Mac Con Glinne* (c. 1100) with onion-leek pottage. He explores Ireland's rigid food hierarchy-peasants ate grains and salted meat, butter signified wealth, monks preferred game, nobles had fresh meat-and cultural practices like fosterage, the 7-year child-rearing system, and a satirical poem about King Cathal's gluttony.
programme.sub-title: Tasting History with Max Miller - Medieval Irish Food: Peasant to King

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max explores lighthouse keeper life via an 1881 provisioning list and period recipes. He covers the isolated, demanding job-cleaning Fresnel lenses with mercury, trimming wicks, and cooking with limited supplies like flour, beans, and salt pork. Featuring keepers Henry Long, Mary Ryan, and Hannah Thomas, he recreates Fannie Farmer's 1896 Boston corn chowder with pilot bread.
programme.sub-title: Tasting History with Max Miller - Eating like a Lighthouse Keeper from the 1800's

programme.title: Ciao Italia
programme.desc: Mary Ann teaches her Scuola Culinaria student, Karen the traditional Italian culinary secrets of creating soft-as-a-cloud, pillowy gnocchi every time. When they're as perfect as these Amalfi-style gnocchi, all that's needed is a buttery, heavy cream sauce of asparagus tips and lemon zest to make you close your eyes, take one taste and swear you're in Amalfi.
programme.sub-title: Ciao Italia - Got Lemons, Make Gnocchi

programme.title: Ciao Italia
programme.desc: In a matter of minutes, Mary Ann combines sliced chicken breasts with onions, garlic, and turmeric and into the oven it goes to create her husband's recipe Guy's Chicken with Olives and Turmeric. Then she makes another favorite, Meatballs Milan Style. Stuffed with filled with mortadella, beef, and ham and fried to a crunchy crisp, you'll want seconds, thirds, fourths!
programme.sub-title: Ciao Italia - Gaetano's Easy Chicken Casserole

programme.title: Ciao Italia
programme.desc: Mary Ann and eager Scuola Culinaria student John roll up their sleeves and dive into the essential steps need to create an all-time favorite of favorites, Pizza Margherita. Step by step, sauce by sauce, cheese by cheese learn how to take your pizza all the way from yeast to "Yay!" And they're not done yet, not until they make Fried Dough with Cinnamon and Sugar from yeast to "Yum!"
programme.sub-title: Ciao Italia - Make Pizza with a Friend

programme.title: Ciao Italia
programme.desc: Mary Ann teams up with Executive Chef David Crinieri to wow her cooking students by exploring the world of perfect pestos. Chef David leads off with a delicate Watercress Pesto tossed with Fresh Spinach Linguine and topped with an Artichoke Crudo. Mary Ann's up next with her signature Broccolini and Artichoke Pesto tossed with Fusilli. Want perfect pesto every time? Try either one-or both!

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia heads to South Carolina to meet the many talented artisans that define Lowcountry. From a basket weaver who is keeping the sweetgrass tradition of the Gullah Geechee people alive, to an intercoastal inspired shrimp recipe served in ironware crafted right down the street. Find out why the Lowcountry is defined by its character as much as it is a spot on the map.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Heritage of the Lowcountry

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia travels to a festival in the Ozarks where she is teaching a cooking class. We follow her as she prepares and gathers her ingredients - we meet a small town chicken farmer, gather produce at the local farmers market, and set the table at a local textile studio where Georgia learns to dye napkins.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Discover Your Roots

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Join Georgia on an urban foraging expedition and learn from an edible and medicinal plants expert as he and Georgia collect a variety of items during a walk through the neighborhood. From flower studded ice cubes, to honeysuckle tea, to dandelion green salad, Georgia is making the most of what is around her.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Into the Wild

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Women from around the country convene in west Texas for a transformative experience in the wild. During the episode, Georgia teaches viewers about the different cuts of venison and the ways to cook them, as well as how to save money by grinding your own meat. The guests and viewers will leave feeling empowered and with a different perspective on what it is to be a human and an omnivore.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Go West, Young Woman

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia hosts a dinner party at her home in Austin, Texas, focusing on ingredients that are as locally sourced and homemade as possible. Pulling produce from her own garden, she turns it into pickled vegetables, tomato bread salad, a lemon balm cocktail and more! Georgia even decorates the dinner table entirely with items she has found in nature.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Entertaining at Home

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia travels back to the South of France, where she once cooked at a Michelin restaurant, and spends time in the olive harvest with a family who is carrying on the tradition of making olive oil. We learn about the herbs that are grown by a farmer late in the season to be infused in the olive oil, and how the oil is used by the baker who is baking bread using heirloom wheat.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - France: The Noble Olive

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia travels to the Rosebud Native American Reservation in South Dakota and spends time with the Lakota people who are pursuing the "7-generation framework" - their vision for the next 150 years. She learns about the work they are doing to reclaim their food sovereignty, their culture and language, to bring their people back to that sacred place of equilibrium that is essential in building a strong and sovereign tribal nation - where they are physically, spiritually, and mentally whole.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - The Lakota Nation: A Story of Empowerment

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia visits the Catskills in New York, where a couple has created a stunning homestead and serves their community through weekly dinners that now attract people from afar. She heads out into the woods, into the root cellar, and into the kitchen with Jake and Elizabeth as they create a beautiful meal for dinner guests. The couple shares how they created this space and offer inspiring ideas for living and entertaining.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - The Bovina Farm and Fermentory Story

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia brings the audience into the kitchen with her to share delicious garden to table recipes. Along the way she pays a visit to an artisan beeswax candle maker who teaches her the art of candle making. Georgia then goes to sit at the pottery wheel with a gifted ceramicist to create candle holders and elements for a table setting.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - From Earth to Art

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Diane visits a famous local marble sculptor en route to visit an old friend and great cook, where she learns the secrets of pinched sweet cheese cakes, ancient sesame-honey confections and more. Back in her own kitchen, she creates a luscious Tinos-style artichoke bread pudding and red mullet in caper sauce, both Tinos traditional specialties.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Tinos: Ancient Marble, Timeless Flavors

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: On Mykonos, Diane discovers the quiet life and food of its local farmers, in contrast to the reputation as a dazzling party island. She tastes onion pie, delicious cured pork, and one of the oldest cheeses in the world, kopanisti, still made on the island. In the kitchen, she makes a garlicky local pasta recipe, and a traditional Greek island fish soup.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Food Secrets Of Mykonos

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Gorgeous cafes, bustling nightlife, yachting and water sports, just 20 minutes south of the Greek capital, Athens. Diane visits a fish market where the catch is right off the boat, sails the coast, and returns to her kitchen to create three delicious, contemporary Greek recipes, inspired by the cosmopolitan bustle and fun-loving spirit of the Athenian coast.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - The Athenian Riviera

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Diane and friend and ultramarathoner, Dean Karnazes, meet up for a run. He helps Diane hone her technique, sharing healthy eating tips. Together they make a simple Greek salad with local ingredients and enjoy perfect Mediterranean living. Back in her kitchen, Diane cooks up a very healthy plant-forward Messinian meal, with lots of olive oil, beans and greens.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - The Navarino Challenge

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Diane explores everything from beguiling mastiha, to the local pasta to unique tomatoes, dangling like giant rubies against the renowned geometric patterns on medieval houses of Pyrgi. The flavors of historic Chios inspire her to cook up a succulent chicken and quince dish and an easy traditional black eyed pea salad with Mastiha vinaigrette.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Tasty Teardrops And Tomatoes: Chios

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Naxos is famed for the quality of its meats, its array of cow's milk and sheep-and-goats' milk cheeses and for its potatoes. Diane heads from the shore straight to a remote mountain hideaway with Alexis in tow, where two local cooks await them with a feast of stuffed lamb, potatoes, and a unique skillet pumpkin-onion pie.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Naxos: Meat & Potatoes Like You Never Had'em

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Near the historic Bay of Navarino, blanketed by olive, citrus trees and home to historical culinary artifacts unearthed in prehistoric clay tablets at Pylos, Diane cooks with two village ladies, making a local pork and fig dish, and olive-oil fried bread. Inspired by the cornucopia of olive oil, oranges and other local delicacies, she cooks up a Messinian meal.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - A Meal In Messinia

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: The second-largest Greek island and an hour from Athens, Diane heads out in search of mushrooms with a local mushroom forager and cultivator. They cook a favorite local recipe "kritharoto," mushrooms with orzo. Diane makes three delectable dishes with mushrooms, wine and local ingrediants, inspired by the flavors of this nearby "secret" land.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Evia - An Island Hiding In Plain Sight

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals
programme.desc: Sara's in Barcelona to sip gin and tonics in the shadow of the iconic Sagreda Familia, then joins a food writer to make classic Iberico Pork with Romanesco sauce and Gambas Ajillo. At home, Sara whips up Fideo - Barcelona's take on Paella made with noodles instead of rice.
programme.sub-title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Barcelona: Gaudi, Gin And Gambas

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals
programme.desc: Fish is on the menu when Sara joins Greek Chef Maria Loi harborside near Athens to cook lemony, crispy skinned Branzino along with Beet, Beans and Feta Salad and Lemon Potatoes. Then it's off to Athen's Central Market to buy Retsina at a famous tavern for a rooftop mezze party in the shadow of the Acropolis. Back at home, Sara uses canned sardines for a quick and easy pantry taco.
programme.sub-title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Under The Acropolis

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals
programme.desc: Sara kicks off with a street food tour in Rome led by American Ex Pat Katie Parla. Then, they perform a Roman hat trick - three pastas starting with the same delicious base: Gricia made with guanciale transforms into Amatriciana by adding tomatoes or Carbonara by adding eggs. In her own kitchen, Sara makes baked penne with prosciutto and Fontina cheese.
programme.sub-title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Essential Pastas of Rome

programme.title: Treyvaud Travels
programme.desc: Treyvaud travels to Enniskillen to meet Pat O'Doherty and his famous pigs. Paul is given a master class in butchery and then travels by boat to see the world famous 'black bacon' pigs run wild on their very own private island!

programme.title: Treyvaud Travels
programme.desc: Treyvaud travels to the mighty Thomond Park to cook on the pitch of Munster RFC and meets world rugby legend Doug Howlett. Then it's off to the stunning Adare Village where Paul meets up with his old pal Wade Murphy of 1826 Restaurant.

programme.title: Treyvaud Travels
programme.desc: Treyvaud travels to the stunning coastal town of Ballycastle in County Antrim, where he visits the beautifully located Ballycastle farmers market and then cooks a fantastic scallop dish on board one of the local boats.

programme.title: Treyvaud Travels
programme.desc: Treyvaud travels to the breath taking Dursey Island in Cork, home of Irelands only cable car, to learn how to cook fresh scones and jam. After, he cooks up an amazing lobster dish with the Wild Atlantic Way as his backdrop!

programme.title: Treyvaud Travels
programme.desc: Treyvaud travels to meet master smoker Paul Curry, later cooking a great dish while gaining exclusive access to one of Irelands most stunning private castles. Then its off to Corick House Hotel & Spa for a spot of foraging and more great recipes!

programme.title: Treyvaud Travels
programme.desc: Treyvaud travels to Long Meadow Cider company to see how father and son team make their incredible cider.

programme.title: Treyvaud Travels
programme.desc: Treyvaud travels to Killarney and cooks a healthy dish on a jaunting car whilst being whisked through the stunning national Park. Then hikes up Cardiac Hill before having a pint in The Killarney Brewing Company.

programme.title: Treyvaud Travels
programme.desc: Treyvaud travels to Quinns pub in Dungannon to look back at his entire series. We get to see hilarious unseen footage, bloopers and some of Treyvaud's most favorite moments of his amazing travels.

programme.title: Almazan Kitchen
programme.desc: Hottest Burger in The World and Big Ribeye with French Fries
programme.sub-title: Almazan Kitchen - Hottest Burger in The World and Big Ribeye with French Fries

programme.title: Almazan Kitchen
programme.desc: Quesadilla, Bushcraft Bolognese and World's Hottest Ribeye - Carolina reaper
programme.sub-title: Almazan Kitchen - Quesadilla, Bushcraft Bolognese, World's Hottest Ribeye - Carolina reaper

programme.title: Almazan Kitchen
programme.desc: Violet Double Burrito and Cheeseburger 2021
programme.sub-title: Almazan Kitchen - Violet Double Burrito, Cheeseburger 2021

programme.title: Almazan Kitchen
programme.desc: Peking Duck and Crispy Curry Pie
programme.sub-title: Almazan Kitchen - Peking Duck, Crispy Curry Pie

programme.title: Almazan Kitchen
programme.desc: Chicken Wings (Grza, Rupa), Alien Chicken Roast Zabrega and Watermill Hot Dog
programme.sub-title: Almazan Kitchen - Chicken Wings (Grza, Rupa), Alien Chicken Roast Zabrega, Watermill Hot Dog

programme.title: Almazan Kitchen
programme.desc: Chicken Rope Rolls, Bacon & Eggs Pan Pie and Burger Pie
programme.sub-title: Almazan Kitchen - Chicken Rope Rolls, Bacon & Eggs Pan Pie, Burger Pie

programme.title: Chasing Coffee
programme.desc: Coffee expert Joey Chase goes on a pilgrimage along an ancient Ethiopian trading route that starts with the modern latte art cafes in Addis Ababa, then through the coffee kingdom of Jimma to the 10,000+-year-old wild coffee Yayu Forest. Village elders share the age-old secrets of hand processing, fire-pit roasting, and brewing of beans followed by a traditional feast.

programme.title: Chasing Coffee
programme.desc: After sharing a first-ever taste of coffee in a remote Maasai village, followed by an exploration of the terrain with some new-found friends, Joey explores a grandiose coffee estate in Mt. Kenya. He then jousts with coffee buyers in Nairbobi's auction house and experiences the hand sorting and elaborate tasting of over 100 distinctive coffees in a British Tudor-style plantation cottage.

programme.title: Chasing Coffee
programme.desc: Touting the practicality of gondola travel, Joey explores the canals of Venice and discovers the oldest coffee shop in Europe. The trail to classic Italian espresso leads from Illy Coffee near the high-fashion metropolis of Trieste to the medieval town of Scarperia where espresso machines are manufactured. Florence boasts a famous barista who prepares a masterful farewell espresso.

programme.title: Chasing Coffee
programme.desc: Joey hits the streets of Bogota to check out the controversial trade in emeralds, the famous Juan Valdez Cafe, and some classic Colombian cuisine at an elevation of 10,000 feet. A flight to Armenia and subsequent Willy's Jeep trek uncover a remote and hidden world of quaint coffee towns and boutique farms where Joey hosts a group of international coffee buyers.

programme.title: Chasing Coffee
programme.desc: Joey is welcomed to Sao Paulo with a freshly brewed cup of excellence at The Coffee Lab in the trendy Madalena district. Joey checks out big coffee exporting in the Port of Santos with shipping containers stacked like legos, Jaco bird coffee (foraged from bird poop), and the world's largest savannah grassland, where Daterra Coffee Farms researches small-lot coffees on a massive scale.

programme.title: Welcome to My Farm
programme.desc: Lisa visits a local sugar shack to learn how maple syrup is made during the early spring maple syrup season in Maine. Back at home, she bakes a maple walnut cake, then treats her chickens to some winter treats and shares an easy DIY project for the chicken coop.
programme.sub-title: Welcome to My Farm - Maine Maple Sunday

programme.title: Welcome to My Farm
programme.desc: Lisa visits a local farm for some expert tips for growing strawberries in Maine, then she shares her secret family strawberry shortcake recipe. She's also growing basil this summer, so she adds some fresh basil and strawberries to her homemade lemonade.
programme.sub-title: Welcome to My Farm - Strawberry Fields Forever

programme.title: Welcome to My Farm
programme.desc: It's spring in Maine, so Lisa is planting seeds and getting ready for baby chicks. After making a fun DIY project for her chickens who lay eggs, she shares her best tips and attempts to get one of her hens to raise some baby chicks, then shares a recipe for Scotch Eggs.
programme.sub-title: Welcome to My Farm - The Chicks are Coming!

programme.title: Welcome to My Farm
programme.desc: Meet some of Lisa's poultry pals, including a curious Indian runner duck named Fern and one of her French Marans hens who lays gorgeous chocolate brown eggs. Then she shares some of her best tips for raising a mixed flock of chickens, ducks and geese.
programme.sub-title: Welcome to My Farm - Poultry Pals

programme.title: Welcome to My Farm
programme.desc: Lisa makes a visit to a lavender farm in Maine to learn all about growing and using the aromatic herb in baking and to make a natural chicken coop spray. Back at home, she bakes lavender cupcakes, makes some ice cream, then makes a chicken-themed cornhole game for the backyard.
programme.sub-title: Welcome to My Farm - Lavender in Bloom

programme.title: Welcome to My Farm
programme.desc: Lisa makes a small basket using wood scraps and wire. Then she takes a trip to a local orchard and bakes an apple pie with some of the apples she's picked. She demonstrates how to make homemade apple cider vinegar, introduces several of her chickens, then makes them some apple treats.
programme.sub-title: Welcome to My Farm - Apple of my Eye

programme.title: Welcome to My Farm
programme.desc: Lisa shares some basic cooking tips for scrambling, frying and poaching eggs, as well as her secret for perfectly peeled hard-boiled eggs, and then makes a few of her favorite egg recipes including omelets, Eggs Benedict and her unique twist on deviled eggs. She also explains proper egg storage and why some eggs don't need to be refrigerated.
programme.sub-title: Welcome to My Farm - Scrambled It is

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals
programme.desc: Sara's in Barcelona to sip gin and tonics in the shadow of the iconic Sagreda Familia, then joins a food writer to make classic Iberico Pork with Romanesco sauce and Gambas Ajillo. At home, Sara whips up Fideo - Barcelona's take on Paella made with noodles instead of rice.
programme.sub-title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Barcelona: Gaudi, Gin And Gambas

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals
programme.desc: In Naples, Sara unlocks the secret recipe for the best Neapolitan pizza at the famous Gino Sorbillos. Fried meat filled pizza may be even better than that, or is the best one a unique star shaped pizza? Just across the bay in Sorrento it's all lemons, all the time as Sara visits a proud family of lemon growers. They make a citrus flecked cheese and Grandma's Lemon Pasta.
programme.sub-title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Pizza and Lemons: Naples to Sorrento

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals
programme.desc: Parma, Italy is home to Parmesan cheese, Prosciutto di Parma and some of the best tomatoes in Italy. All three go into a dish Sara cooks with a local chef. You won't find a quicker weeknight meal than his fancy sounding Tagliatelle con Crema di Parmigiana Passata. Sara's Parsley and Asparagus salad makes it a meal. Later, Sara cooks with Italian American chef Joey Campanaro.
programme.sub-title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Bounty of Parma

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals
programme.desc: How do you make any dish even more delicious? Just add cheese! To prove the point Sara's got two recipes: a French Onion Soup Burger topped with melty, gooey cheese and an equally gooey Alsatian Onion Pie with caramelized onions and melted Gruyere that puts it over the top. Later, we visit a dairy farm and then on 'Ask Sara', an easy homemade ricotta.

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals
programme.desc: Sara's strategy for easy weeknight cooking? Simply cook a dish one night, then repurpose it into a different meal for another night. Maya Kaimal joins Sara to make Turkey Keema with sweet potatoes and ground meat. On another night, that morphs into Indian stuffed peppers. Then Sara Sautee's Duck Breasts for a quick meal. She uses those same Duck Breasts in a mouthwatering Peking Duck Wrap.
programme.sub-title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Weeknight Two for One

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals
programme.desc: Holidays and special occasions call for showstopping main courses that take a little extra time. Vegetarians, this one's for you - Sara's elegant Butternut Squash and Date Crostata. Then it's Sara's crispy Roast Duck with Duck Fat Popovers. Also a feature on a woman who is saving the recipes of Italian grandmothers she calls 'Pasta Grannies'.

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals
programme.desc: Cooking fish can be tricky but not with these easy, foolproof fish recipes. First, Sara is joined by food journalist and influencer Anna Gass to make Pesce all'Acqua Pazza. Then Sara goes to Key West to cook with chef Norman Van Aken. He makes a local Bahamian Soup with fresh caught snapper and a "Cut Up" Salad, a potluck of fruit, plucked from the dinner guests trees.

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals
programme.desc: In Spain, paella is so popular there are competitions between towns for the best recipe. It is especially so in Valencia, where Sara cooks with local chef Franck Garanger. If we didn't have you at Paella, just wait for the dinner where it's eaten right out of the pan with special rules for pilfering your dinner partners portion. Then, Sara sautés fish topped with a colorful Gazpacho Vinaigrette.
programme.sub-title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Sketches of Spain

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals
programme.desc: A food tour of Tunisia's Sidi Bou Said with local chef Malek Labidi ends cooking Shakshuka in a beautiful garden overlooking the sea. Later we dive into the Medina in Tunis to watch women hand make couscous. In Istanbul, a shopping trip with local TV chef Refika Burgul, ends in the kitchen making Salt Cured Sea Bass plus the addictive Turkish beef and French fry favorite, Kochertme.
programme.sub-title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - A Taste Of Tunisia And Turkey

programme.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens

programme.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don continues his grand garden tour of Italy. This time he is in Naples to visit some of the most sublime, romantic retreats in southern Italy. After all the formality of the green gardens around Rome and Florence, Monty seeks out idyllic horticultural gems set against the dramatic scenery of the Amalfi Coast to discover why, in the south, gardens are informal and, above all, filled with flowers.

programme.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam
programme.desc: Luke visits Huế - famous for its heritage and cuisine - and Con Hen Village to learn a technique for de-shelling baby clams, searches for best bowl of spicy beef noodle soup, and stops by a business where they make turmeric vermicelli noodle salad!

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam
programme.desc: After a long trip from Hue, Luke finally gets some rest in the scenic Ninh Bihn. Tag along as Luke meets with a local rice farmer, takes a canoe out for some crab hunting, and ventures deep into the jungle in search of a local delicacy- red ant eggs!

programme.desc: Learning about the Dead Sea Scrolls and their discovery; ancient Judaism and early Christianity prior to the scrolls; the uncovering of the scrolls and how they alter one's understanding of every aspect of the historical period of their creation.

programme.title: The Dead Sea Scrolls
programme.desc: Diving into a tale of excitement and adventure and discovering more about how scholars gain access to the first seven scrolls discovered at Qumran; what they find when they begin to translate the extraordinary initial discoveries.

programme.title: The Dead Sea Scrolls
programme.desc: Immersing into the text of the scrolls, starting with the scroll known as the Community Rule or Manual of Discipline; the important text that gives one the first insight into the community and theology of the scrolls' creators and guardians.
programme.sub-title: Opening and Reading the First Scroll

programme.title: The Dead Sea Scrolls
programme.desc: Examining history prior to the scrolls, beginning with the biblical period and moving to the Maccabean revolt; the arrival of the Romans; King Herod's reign; the life of Jesus; the Zealot revolt; the destruction of Jerusalem and the fall of Masada.
programme.sub-title: The Historical Backdrop of Ancient Judaism

programme.title: The Dead Sea Scrolls
programme.desc: Jewish sectarianism in late antiquity; focusing on the Sadducees, Pharisees, Essenes and Zealots through Josephus, the Jewish philosopher Philo and the authors of the New Testament books; the later rabbis; Roman polymath Pliny the Elder.
programme.sub-title: The Rise of the Jewish Sects

programme.title: The Dead Sea Scrolls
programme.desc: Visiting the isolated region of Qumran's caves; learning how archeological excavations of a nearby ruin help scholars form the most accepted hypothesis of who writes the scrolls and why the scrolls are deposited in the caves.
programme.sub-title: The Dead Sea Site of the Qumran Sect

programme.title: The Dead Sea Scrolls
programme.desc: Stepping forward in time and examining some later rabbinic texts from the third century; the rise of the rabbinical tradition; vital perspectives on the composition of the Dead Sea Scrolls.
programme.sub-title: The Emergence of the Rabbinic System

programme.title: The Dead Sea Scrolls

programme.sub-title: A Dead Sea Scroll from Medieval Cairo

programme.desc: The physical evidence paints a picture of the Bronze Age in Scandinavia; Viking ancestors trade Arctic goods, amber and slaves in exchange for foreign copper and tin; new wealth fosters larger villages; the beginnings of the Norse pantheon.
programme.sub-title: Scandinavian Society in the Bronze Age

programme.title: The Vikings
programme.desc: Scandinavia survives on trade with the Celts; contact with Rome enriches the upper classes; Scandinavians returning from Roman military service bring back advanced weapons and armor; petty kings and the first Scandinavian sailing ships emerge.
programme.sub-title: Scandinavia in the Celtic and Roman Ages

programme.title: Cities of the Ancient World
programme.desc: Cities are integral to modern lives; why wandering ancient humans leave the forests and plains to create settlements; the fundamental question of "why" is the first step toward understanding the inhabitants and lessons from ancient cities.

programme.title: Cities of the Ancient World
programme.desc: Imagining a city with no streets, public buildings or common spaces; the world's first city offers an intriguing window into life in the Neolithic era; exploring the remains of Çatalhöyük's family housing, murals and religious shrines.
programme.sub-title: Çatalhöyük - First Experiment in Urban Living

programme.title: Cities of the Ancient World
programme.desc: The story of the walls of Jericho in the Book of Joshua; looking past the biblical story; what architectural remains suggest about Jericho, whose ritual spaces help create a community and whose walls help define the urban environment.

programme.title: Cities of the Ancient World
programme.desc: Looking at one of the most marvelous cities in the ancient world; Uruk exhibits many of the hallmarks of ancient civilization; division of labor among its craftsmen; a class hierarchy that includes professional priests; records of art and literature.

programme.title: Late Antiquity: Crisis and Transformation
programme.desc: Exploring the origin of the term late antiquity; why this historical view better reflects the period from the third to the eighth centuries than the traditional view that Rome has a decline and fall; the major themes and issues of the course.

programme.title: Late Antiquity: Crisis and Transformation
programme.desc: The crisis of the third century, when Rome finds its frontiers threatened on several fronts; armies make and unmake emperors with alarming regularity; the literature of the period also reveals unmistakable feelings of despair and uncertainty.

programme.title: Late Antiquity: Crisis and Transformation
programme.desc: No one predicts that Rome is about to raise two of its greatest rulers, Diocletian and Constantine; Diocletian institutes a series of reforms that divide the empire into east and west; launching the last and fiercest persecution of Christians.

programme.title: Late Antiquity: Crisis and Transformation
programme.desc: Turning to Constantine; how he extends Diocletian's reforms; among them, he gives the empire a new capital at Byzantium, which he renames Constantinople after himself; he also takes the surprising step of legalizing Christianity.

programme.title: Conquest of the Americas
programme.desc: Neither the Eurocentric term 'discovery' nor the blandly neutral 'encounters' do justice to the impact of Europeans, Africans and Native Americans coming together in the New World; a collision whose causes and effects are outlined in this lecture.

programme.title: Conquest of the Americas
programme.desc: Most of the inhabitants of the Americas arrive in migratory waves from Asia between 40,000 and 2,000 B.C.; their civilizations are based on sophisticated irrigation and farming; complex religions and social structures; rivaling those of Europe.

programme.title: Conquest of the Americas
programme.desc: The Aztecs and Incas create empires built upon religions of conquest; powered by the control of water, around Lake Texcoco in Mexico and high in the Andes Mountains, respectively; the Maya develops an advanced knowledge of astronomy and mathematics.

programme.title: Conquest of the Americas
programme.desc: Europe and Africa are connected for centuries by Old World trading networks centered around the Mediterranean; in the 15th century, Spain and Portugal shift the trade out of the Mediterranean and into the Atlantic, along the west coast of Africa.

programme.title: America After the Cold War: The First 30 Years
programme.desc: The end of the Cold War is a key point in history; the rapid collapse of the Soviet Union; the fall of the Berlin Wall; delving into the American story in the early 1990s; conflicts in Kuwait and Bosnia test America's new role in a post-Soviet world.

programme.title: America After the Cold War: The First 30 Years
programme.desc: Bill Clinton's presidency dominates the domestic news in the 1990s. From his dramatic showdown with Newt Gingrich and the Republican Congress's Contract with America, this is a presidency of high drama; surveying the tumultuous decade.

programme.title: America After the Cold War: The First 30 Years
programme.desc: The end of the Cold War may have reshaped the world order, but 9/11 and the subsequent war on terror changes America; tracing the events leading up to the terrorist attack on American soil on Sept. 11, 2001; learning why 19 hijackers attack America.
programme.sub-title: A New Millennium, George W. Bush, and 9/11

programme.title: America After the Cold War: The First 30 Years
programme.desc: Historians discuss and debate the wars in Afghanistan and Iraq; the war in Afghanistan has some justification, given the role of Al-Qaeda in 9/11; Professor Allitt reviews the facts surrounding the war in Iraq; the war's effect on the United States.
programme.sub-title: The US Wars in Afghanistan and Iraq

programme.title: Tocqueville and the American Experiment
programme.desc: The course begins with a brief overview of Tocqueville's masterwork; written to educate the French about democracy; it is originally published as two separate volumes, released five years apart.
programme.sub-title: An Overview of Democracy in America

programme.title: Tocqueville and the American Experiment
programme.desc: William R. Cook introduces the young French nobleman, trained as a lawyer; his most famous book is only one achievement in a life marked by several; service as France's foreign minister; a history of the French Revolution regarded as a classic.

programme.title: Tocqueville and the American Experiment
programme.desc: Tocqueville rarely describes specific events or conversations; his letters and journals allow one to follow him on his trip; getting an excellent feel for the experiences he and his colleague, Gustave de Beaumont, have in America.

programme.title: Tocqueville and the American Experiment
programme.desc: This lecture considers the meaning and implications of what Tocqueville introduces in the first paragraph of "Democracy in America"; the foundation of the democratic enterprise; the concept he calls equality of conditions.

programme.title: America in the Gilded Age and Progressive Era
programme.desc: The key historical forces that characterize the Gilded Age and the Progressive Era; the competing ideals that define these eras; the US in 1865; the extraordinary social, political and economic changes unleashed by the devastation of the Civil War.

programme.title: America in the Gilded Age and Progressive Era
programme.desc: The Reconstruction era following the Civil War; governmental policies and legislation enacted to safeguard the welfare of former slaves and average citizens; these policies are progressively dismantled, the South comes under the rule of the whites.

programme.title: America in the Gilded Age and Progressive Era
programme.desc: The story of the conquest of the American West; key myths surrounding the West and how it is settled; the motives and realities of westward migration; the components of the western economy; the conflicts with Native Americans that lead to violence.
programme.sub-title: Buffalo Bill Cody and the Myth of the West

programme.title: America in the Gilded Age and Progressive Era
programme.desc: America rises from a developing nation status in 1865 to become a great industrial power by 1900; the unfolding of the American industrial revolution; the advent of big business in the railroad, steel and oil industries; consumerism and advertising.

programme.title: Tremors 5: Bloodlines
programme.desc: Survivalist Burt Gummer (Michael Gross) and his new sidekick Travis (Jamie Kennedy) are hired to track down an ass-blaster terrorizing South Africa. As they engage in battles with the aggressive creatures, they discover an even more lethal creature.

programme.title: Tremors: A Cold Day in Hell
programme.desc: Burt Gummer suspects that giant worms are being utilized as weapons at a research facility in Canada. He soon finds himself in a race against time to create an antidote from one of the creature's venom to save his own life.

programme.title: Darkman
programme.desc: When thugs employed by a crime boss lead a vicious assault on Dr. Peyton Wilder, leaving him literally and psychologically scarred, an emergency procedure allows him to survive. Upon his recovery, Wilder can find solace only by returning to his scientific work developing synthetic skin, and seeking revenge against the crime boss. He assumes a phantom avenger persona called Darkman, who, with malleable facial qualities, is able to infiltrate and sow terror in the criminal community.

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: In remote Antarctica, a group of American research scientists are disturbed at their base camp by a helicopter shooting at a sled dog. When they take in the dog, it brutally attacks both human beings and canines in the camp, and they discover that the beast can assume the shape of its victims. A resourceful helicopter pilot and the camp doctor lead the camp crew in a desperate, gory battle against the vicious creature before it picks them all off, one by one.

programme.title: Firestarter
programme.desc: As youths, Andy McGee and his future wife, Vicky, participated in secret experiments, allowing themselves to be subjected to mysterious medical tests. Years later, the couple's daughter, Charlie, begins to exhibit the ability of setting fires solely with her mind. This volatile talent makes the youngster extremely dangerous, and soon she becomes a target for the enigmatic agency known as "The Shop."

programme.title: Child's Play 2
programme.desc: Two years after serial killer Charles Lee Ray (Brad Dourif) inserted his soul into a Chucky doll, a toy company attempts to re-create the doll, bringing Ray back in the process. The possessed doll, intent on claiming a human body, kills his way toward former owner Andy (Alex Vincent), who now lives in a foster home. Andy's foster sister, Kyle (Christine Elise), tries to protect him, but his foster parents believe Andy is just a troubled kid -- and Chucky's murderous path continues.

programme.title: Drop Dead Fred
programme.desc: An unhappy housewife (Phoebe Cates) gets a lift from the return of her imaginary childhood friend, Drop Dead Fred (Rik Mayall).

programme.title: Howard the Duck
programme.desc: In this film based on the comic book character, Howard the Duck is suddenly beamed from Duckworld, a planet of intelligent ducks with arms and legs, to Earth, where he lands in Cleveland. There he saves rocker Beverly from thugs and forms a friendship with her. She introduces him to Phil, who works at a lab with scientist Dr. Jenning. When the doctor attempts to return Howard to his world, Jenning instead transfers an evil spirit into his own body.

programme.title: The 'Burbs
programme.desc: Settling in for some time off in his suburban home, Ray Peterson's vacation becomes a horror when the Klopeks, a suspiciously odd family, move in down the block. Enlisting the aid of his paranoid buddy, Art, and his militia-man neighbor, Rumsfield, Ray sends his son and wife away on a trip while he investigates the Klopeks. When a neighbor disappears, Ray and his cohorts risk their lives to save their cul-de-sac from the clutches of evil.

programme.title: Grand-Daddy Day Care
programme.desc: A man has to figure out a way to make extra money when his father-in-law moves in.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop 2
programme.desc: A gruff FBI agent goes undercover as a kindergarten teacher. He's there to recover stolen data, but first he'll have to learn to survive in the politically correct world of elementary education.

programme.title: About a Boy
programme.desc: A comedy-drama starring Hugh Grant as Will, a rich, child-free and irresponsible Londoner in his thirties who, in search of available women, invents an imaginary son and starts attending single parent meetings. As a result of one of his liaisons, he meets Marcus, an odd 12-year-old boy with problems at school. Gradually, Will and Marcus become friends, and as Will teaches Marcus how to be a cool kid, Marcus helps Will to finally grow up.

programme.title: Fried Green Tomatoes
programme.desc: On one of trapped housewife Evelyn Couch's (Kathy Bates) Wednesday nursing home visits, she encounters Ninny Threadgoode (Jessica Tandy), a colorful old woman who brightens Evelyn's outlook by sharing tales from her past. As Ninny recounts the exploits of her free-spirited sister-in-law Idgie (Mary Stuart Masterson), owner of a small Alabama café in the 1920s, and the bond Idgie shared with her friend Ruth (Mary-Louise Parker), Evelyn gains the confidence to change her own life for the better.

programme.title: Parenthood
programme.desc: Perfectionist Gil Buckman (Steve Martin) struggles with the deficiencies of his children, thinking they reflect poorly on his parenting -- and Gil's siblings only add to the stress of his life. One of his sisters (Dianne Wiest) faces difficulty when her teenage daughter (Martha Plimpton) becomes pregnant. Another (Harley Jane Kozak) clashes with her husband (Rick Moranis) when she asks for more children. Gil's immature brother (Tom Hulce) turns up as well, with a young son he can barely handle.

programme.title: Sisters
programme.desc: When their parents decide to sell their home, siblings Maura (Amy Poehler) and Kate (Tina Fey) learn that they have one weekend to clean out the junk from their old bedroom. Unhappy with the news, the recently divorced Maura and her hotheaded sister make plans to throw one final bash to recapture their glory days with their former classmates. As the raging party begins to spiral out of control, the gals soon realize that there may not be a house left once the dust settles.

programme.title: Head Over Heels
programme.desc: Although she has an excellent job at the Metropolitan Museum of Art and a fabulous apartment with model roommates, New Yorker Amanda Pierce remains unlucky in love and intent on finding the right guy. When she develops a crush on neighbor Jim Winston, she begins to spy on him and witnesses his apparent involvement in a murder. Since things don't add up, she tries to figure out what really happened — and if she still has a shot at dating the guy.

programme.title: Patch Adams
programme.desc: After struggling with depression in a mental hospital, Hunter "Patch" Adams decides he wants to become a doctor. He enrolls at Virginia Medical University but is disillusioned by the school's clinical perspective on patient care. With the aid of a wealthy friend, Adams opens his own medical clinic for those without insurance. He forms a deep bond with fellow medical student Carin Fisher before a tragedy causes Adams to re-evaluate his approach.

programme.title: Reality Bites
programme.desc: After college, Lelaina (Winona Ryder) films a documentary about herself and friends as they flounder in their attempts to forge relationships and begin careers. Vickie (Janeane Garofalo) works retail, has an endless string of one-night stands and awaits the results of her HIV test. Sammy (Steve Zahn) tries to come out to his parents. Lelaina gets involved with yuppie Michael (Ben Stiller) while maintaining a love-hate relationship with Troy (Ethan Hawke), who's undergoing an existential crisis.

programme.title: The Skeleton Key
programme.desc: Caroline Ellis (Kate Hudson), a good-natured nurse living in New Orleans, quits her job at a hospice to work for Violet Devereaux (Gena Rowlands), an elderly woman whose husband, Ben (John Hurt), is in poor health following a stroke. When Caroline begins to explore the couple's rundown Bayou mansion, she discovers strange artifacts and learns the house has a mysterious past. As she continues to investigate, she realizes that Violet is keeping a sinister secret about the cause of Ben's illness.

programme.title: The Last House on the Left
programme.desc: Mari and her friend look forward to a holiday at the remote Collingwood lake house, but instead an escaped convict (Garret Dillahunt) and his crew kidnap them and later leave them for dead. Mari makes her way back home, where her parents, John (Tony Goldwyn) and Emma (Monica Potter), have unwittingly offered shelter to the thugs. When John and Emma find out what happened to their daughter, they decide to make the strangers rue the day they harmed Mari.

programme.title: Doom
programme.desc: A team of space marines known as the Rapid Response Tactical Squad, led by Sarge (Karl Urban), is sent to a science facility on Mars after somebody reports a security breach. There, they learn that the alert came after a test subject, a mass murderer purposefully injected with alien DNA, broke free and began killing people. Dr. Grimm (Rosamund Pike), who is related to team member Reaper (The Rock), informs them all that the chromosome can mutate humans into monsters -- and is highly infectious.

programme.title: Snow White and the Huntsman
programme.desc: Queen Ravenna (Charlize Theron), who seized control of her kingdom by marrying and killing its rightful ruler, needs the life force of young maidens to maintain her beauty. However, to become truly immortal, Ravenna must consume the heart of her stepdaughter Snow White (Kristen Stewart). Snow escapes, and Ravenna dispatches a huntsman (Chris Hemsworth) to capture her. But Snow, the Huntsman and a rebel army join forces to destroy Ravenna and restore the balance of life and death.

programme.title: The Wolfman
programme.desc: Though absent from his ancestral home of Blackmoor for many years, aristocrat Lawrence Talbot returns to find his missing brother at the request of the latter's fiancée, Gwen. He learns that a creature has links to an ancient curse turning people into werewolves when the moon is full. To save the village and protect Gwen, he must slay the bloodthirsty beast, but he contends with a horrifying family legacy.

programme.title: The Mummy Returns
programme.desc: Ten years after the events of the first film, Rick and Evelyn O'Connell are settled in 1935 London, where they are raising their son. When a chain of events finds the corpse of Imhotep resurrected, the O'Connells go on a desperate race to save the world from unspeakable evil and to rescue their son before it is too late.

programme.title: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor
programme.desc: Cursed by a devious sorceress, China's ruthless Dragon Emperor (Jet Li) and his vast army lie buried in clay for millennia. When young archaeologist Alex O'Connell is tricked into reviving the emperor, he and his famous parents (Brendan Fraser, Maria Bello) must find a way to send the ghoul back to the grave before he can awaken his vast army and take over the world.

programme.desc: Lindsay Crouse and Joe Mantegna star as an unlikely team of con artists is David Mamet's directorial debut.

programme.desc: A former thief and a brash young drifter team up to pull off the perfect heist in this bold crime thriller!

programme.title: Thief
programme.desc: A master safe cracker plans one last heist for the sake of a woman...and a whole new life.

programme.title: Thief
programme.desc: A master safe cracker plans one last heist for the sake of a woman...and a whole new life.

programme.title: Into the Blue
programme.desc: Paul Walker and Jessica Alba heat up the screen as two divers who dream of finding hidden treasure.

programme.desc: A farm boy (Sean Penn) looking for excitement finds himself on a collision course with his smooth-talking gang leader father (Christopher Walken) in this "powerfully disturbing" (Newsweek) tale based on the story of real-life killer Bruce Johnston.

programme.title: Gang Related

programme.title: Colors
programme.desc: As members of the Los Angeles Police Department's elite anti-gang unit, a seasoned cop (Robert Duvall) and his new partner (Sean Penn) are called in to assist with the crackdown against the mounting gang violence in the slums of East Los Angeles.

programme.title: The Mod Squad
programme.desc: Three problem teens headed to jail...until a police captain offers them a deal to work for him and go undercover in the hip L.A. club scene.

programme.title: Over The Top
programme.desc: A championship title, a huge cash award, and his son's love -- the greatest prize of all -- are at stake when Lincoln Hawk battles his strongest enemy for everything he has ever wanted. Sylvester Stallone stars in this powerful and exciting film!

programme.title: The Great Train Robbery
programme.desc: Sean Connery plans to steal a fortune in gold from a railroad payroll car and joins forces with a safecracker.

programme.title: Pork Chop Hill
programme.desc: As the Korean War rages, Lieutenant Joe Clemons (Gregory Peck) finds himself standing at a crossroad.

programme.title: Run Silent, Run Deep
programme.desc: The legendary Clark Gable and Burt Lancaster star in this gripping, classic military drama aboard a submarine.

programme.title: The Train
programme.desc: Screen greats Burt Lancaster, Paul Scofield and Jeanne Moreau star in this suspense-laden tale of justice and retribution as a French Resistance fighter (Lancaster) attempts to stop a Nazi commander from looting the art treasures of Paris.

programme.title: Eye Of The Needle
programme.desc: Donald Sutherland stars in this moody thriller as a villainous Nazi spy whose passions betray him via a married woman (Kate Nelligan) in this intriguing blend of romance and espionage against the backdrop of WWII Britain.

programme.title: The Manchurian Candidate
programme.desc: An Army Major discovers a devious plot by a cabal of enemy leaders bent on political upheaval

programme.title: The Package
programme.desc: Gene Hackman and Tommy Lee Jones headline this explosive action-thriller about Green Beret (Hackman) who uncovers a terrifying military conspiracy when he is tasked with escorting a U.S. soldier (Jones) back to the States for a court martial.

programme.title: Red Corner
programme.desc: In this provocative thriller, an American (Richard Gere) on a business trip in China is framed for a brutal murder and soon finds himself at the mercy of a foreign court system he doesn't understand. Can he find the true killer before it's too late?

programme.title: No Way Out
programme.desc: Kevin Costner and Gene Hackman star in this taut, political thriller that sees Costner, as Naval Commander Tom Farrell, on the hunt for a very real killer and a very unreal Russian mole, and all the clues lead back to himself. Sean Young co-stars.

programme.title: Masters Of The Universe
programme.desc: The evil Skeletor (Frank Langella) is poised to conquer the universe. But fear not! He-Man (Dolph Lundgren) has declared war on Skeletor, and the battle between good and evil has come to Earth. Courtney Cox also stars in the epic, action-adventure.

programme.title: The Mechanic
programme.desc: In this nail-biting action film, when an aging hitman (Charles Bronson) takes on an eager apprentice (Jan-Michael Vincent) they become an unmatchable team of killers...until the pupil's ruthlessness puts the two on a deadly collision course!

programme.title: Mr. Majestyk
programme.desc: Cinema tough guy Charles Bronson stars as Majestyk, an ex-con and Vietnam vet, whose efforts to run a farm are thwarted by narrow-minded locals and corrupt cops. But when a Mafia hitman destroys his crop, the farmer's fuse is finally blown.

programme.title: Assassination
programme.desc: Hard-hitting action, cross-country adventure and a government conspiracy that goes all the way to the top highlight this pulse-pounding political thriller in which Charles Bronson must protect the First Lady (Jill Ireland) from ruthless assassins.

programme.title: Death Wish II
programme.desc: Paul Kersey (Charles Bronson) is no victim: He fights back - with a vengeance! After beginning a new life in L.A., Kersey's daughter is viciously assaulted. Now, he won't rest until he tracks the assailants down...and puts them all in the ground!

programme.title: The Way West
programme.desc: Screen icons Kirk Douglas, Robert Mitchum and Richard Widmark star in this in this sumptuous epic as pioneers who travel the treacherous Oregon trail.

programme.title: Dances With Wolves
programme.desc: Kevin Costner, Mary McDonnell and Graham Greene star is this masterpiece that took home 7 Academy Awards, including Best Picture. Sent to protect a U.S. outpost, Lt. John Dunbar (Costner) befriends those he was taught to fear, the Sioux Nation.

programme.title: Comes A Horseman
programme.desc: Set in the American West of the 1940s, a pair of little-guy ranchers join forces against the depredations of a ruthless land baron determined to expand his empire at whatever cost. Starring Jane Fonda, James Caan, and Jason Robards.

programme.title: Rancho Deluxe
programme.desc: Jack (Jeff Bridges) and Cecil (Sam Waterston) are an oddball team of modern-day Montana cattle rustlers, and they've set their sights on a pair of unlikely ranch owners from New York (Clifton James, Elizabeth Ashley). But can they outfox the foxes?

programme.title: The Honkers
programme.desc: James Coburn portrays an aging, philandering rodeo cowboy who returns to his hometown. He must do battle not only in the rodeo arena, but with his desire for personal independence and his contradictory desire to win the respect of his wife and son.

programme.title: Young Billy Young
programme.desc: In this gun-slinging adventure, an aging lawman (Robert Mitchum) teams up with Young Billy Young (Robert Walker), a fast-draw outlaw on the run. But it's an alliance that explodes when the lawman discovers a secret that could rip two towns apart!

programme.title: The Kentuckian
programme.desc: Eli Wakefield (Burt Lancaster) and his son are Kentucky adventurers longing for life on the Texas frontier. They learn, however, that their greatest challenge lies not in the uncharted wilderness, but in the people they meet along the way.

programme.title: Vera Cruz
programme.desc: In this epic Western, two shady mercenaries (Gary Cooper, Burt Lancaster) in Mexico during the 1866 revolution are hired to escort a Countess and her gold to the Mexican army in Vera Cruz and find themselves at odds with the army... and each other!

programme.title: The Unforgiven
programme.desc: John Huston directs Audrey Hepburn in this thrilling, romantic western about a woman who becomes the target of lawless racism and brutality when it is discovered that she was born to the Kiowa tribe but secretly adopted by a white frontier family.

programme.title: John Sturges' The Hallelujah Trail
programme.desc: Chaos reigns on the wide open plains as Burt Lancaster and Lee Remick let loose in this comedy that spoofs nearly every convention of movie westerns.

programme.title: The Scalphunters
programme.desc: Sydney Pollack directs Burt Lancaster, Shelley Winters, Ossie Davis and Telly Savalas in this lively and ribald western about a frontier-wise fur trapper who loses his pelts to a band of Kiowas in exchange for a slave he doesn't want.

programme.title: Valdez Is Coming
programme.desc: In this rousing Western, when a greedy rancher causes the death of an innocent man, former sheriff Bob Valdez (Burt Lancaster) orders him to provide financial support for the widow. But when he refuses, Valdez vows to exact justice at any cost!

programme.title: Lawman
programme.desc: In Michael Winner's unique take on the western, a sheriff (Burt Lancaster) is determined to bring to justice a rancher (Lee J. Cobb) and his hands who accidentally killed an old man during a drunken spree. Robert Ryan and Robert Duvall co-star.

programme.title: Buffalo Bill and the Indians, or Sitting Bull's History Lesson
programme.desc: Buffalo Bill has fought Indians & Civil War battles, but nothing can prepare him for show business! When he signs Sitting Bull for a role in his Wild West Show, the clash of cultures reverberates far beyond the boundaries of their sprawling theater.

programme.title: Ned Kelly
programme.desc: Mick Jagger makes his dynamic screen debut in this explosive tale based on the true-life story of the 19th-century Australian "Armored Bandit," who would become a mythic sagebrush hero even as the law closes in and prepares for an all-out war.

programme.title: Doc
programme.desc: Stacy Keach, Haris Yulin and Faye Dunaway give riveting performances in this controversial and myth-shattering reexamination of the darker side of gunslinger Doc Holliday and the actions that led to the infamous showdown in Tombstone, Arizona.

programme.title: Hour Of The Gun
programme.desc: Director John Sturges presents a reworking of the Wyatt Earp/Doc Holliday legend and the struggle for political control of Tombstone, with a marvelous trio of antagonists: James Garner as Earp, Jason Robards as Holliday, and Robert Ryan as Clanton.

programme.title: Sabata
programme.desc: Get ready for fast-paced, explosive action as Lee Van Cleef stars as Sabata, the mysterious, steely-eyed gunslinger who, after he discovers the masterminds behind an elaborate bank heist, imposes his bullet-laced brand of justice on a guilty town.

programme.title: Adios, Sabata
programme.desc: Under the brutal rule of garrison leader Col. Skimmel, a group of Mexican revolutionaries hire gunslinger Sabata (Yul Brynner) to rob a transport of gold in order to buy weapons. But the Colonel has other plans...taking the gold for himself.

programme.title: Return Of Sabata
programme.desc: The great Lee Van Cleef ("Death Rides a Horse") returns as the famous freewheeling gunslinger Sabata. In this third and final go-round for the enigmatic sharpshooter, Sabata seeks revenge when a band of desperadoes bilks him out of $5,000.

programme.title: Barquero
programme.desc: When a small town on the Paria River is decimated by a group of vile outlaws, the bandits get more than they bargained for after the local bargeman turns the tables on the vicious gang! Lee van Cleef and Warren Oates star in this rousing western.

programme.title: The White Buffalo
programme.desc: Charles Bronson and Will Sampson star as Wild Bill Hickok and Chief Crazy Horse in this one-of-a-kind western that finds both western legends braving the snowy wilderness in search of the demon that haunts them both, the fabled White Buffalo!

programme.title: Chato's Land
programme.desc: Charles Bronson gives a standout performance as an Apache on the run from a blood-thirsty posse led by an ex-Confederate officer (Jack Palance). Eventually, the pursued and the pursuers will become reversed deep into the Apache desert.

programme.title: From Noon Till Three
programme.desc: Charles Bronson plays Graham Dorsey, a bank robber who, through a series of twists and turns finds himself the object of national adoration. A beautiful widow, Amanda Starbuck (Jill Ireland) is responsible for creating this myth.

programme.title: Barbershop 2: Back In Business
programme.desc: Calvin (Ice Cube) is struggling to keep his father's shop alive, competing with a name-brand chain next door!

programme.title: Beauty Shop
programme.desc: When her egotistical boss pushes her a hair too far, top stylist Gina decides to open her own beauty shop!

programme.title: Soul Plane
programme.desc: An all star comedy cast are ready to board the newest airline -- one that gives "fly" a whole new meaning!

programme.title: What's The Worst That Could Happen?
programme.desc: Martin Lawrence and Danny DeVito escalate a battle of egos to epic proportions in this hilarious comedy.

programme.title: Holiday Heart
programme.desc: Holiday (Ving Rhames), a choirmaster by day and a talented female impersonator by night, is lonely and grieving the death of his lover...until he befriends a bright young girl and her drug-addicted mother (Alfre Woodard).

programme.title: Original Gangstas
programme.desc: Action legends return to the genre that made them famous in this big, brassy and action-packed tale!

programme.title: Slaughter
programme.desc: An ex-Vietnam, ex-Green Beret captain (Jim Brown) is out to avenge the murder of his parents by the psychotic Dominic Hoffo (Rip Torn).

programme.title: Truck Turner
programme.desc: The great Isaac Hayes stars as Truck Turner who tracks a sadistic pimp through the mean streets of Los Angeles. Nichelle Nichols also stars.

programme.title: Pressure Point
programme.desc: A prison psychiatrist (the legendary Sidney Poitier) is charged with treating a hate-filled young man (Bobby Darin).

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Sidney Poitier and Rod Steiger shine in this classic mystery-thriller that took home five Academy Awards®, including Best Picture and Best Actor for Steiger.

programme.title: They Call Me Mister Tibbs!
programme.desc: Lt. Virgil Tibbs (Sidney Poitier), asks to be assigned to the case of a reverend accused of murder in San Francisco in hopes of clearing his friend's name.

programme.title: The Organization
programme.desc: Sidney Poitier is back as Lt. Virgil Tibbs! When six masked figures rob a seemingly normal furniture factory, they leave with a multimillion-dollar cache of heroin!

programme.title: Fatal Beauty
programme.desc: A drug called "Fatal Beauty" has hit the streets of Los Angeles, and Rita Rizzoli (Whoopi Goldberg), the city's toughest cop, is out to take down the drug lord responsible!

programme.title: Street Smart
programme.desc: A freelance journalist becomes the toast of the town when he breaks a story about the dirty deeds of a ruthless New York pimp. There's only one problem: Jonathan fabricated the entire thing.

programme.title: Diary of a Hitman
programme.desc: Dekker (Forest Whitaker) is a professional killer. Now, on the eve of his retirement, he must make a deadly decision.

programme.title: Gang Related
programme.desc: Two killers are hiding where no one will ever find them...behind their badges! Tupac Shakur and James Belushi are two corrupt police detectives caught in a dangerous web of deceit in this gritty, smart and tough action thriller.

programme.title: Coffy
programme.desc: A one-woman vigilante force is out for revenge against those who hooked her sister on drugs.

programme.title: Foxy Brown
programme.desc: Foxy Brown (Pam Grier) vows vengeance against those responsible for the death of an undercover officer.

programme.title: Sheba, Baby
programme.desc: Pam Grier plays Sheba Shayne, a private eye who is called back to her hometown to stop the local mob boss from moving in on her father's loan business.

programme.title: Friday Foster
programme.desc: A photojournalist Friday Foster (Pam Grier) witnesses the attempted assassination of a prominent African-American figure. Now she is a target!

programme.title: Salt & Pepper
programme.desc: Legendary Rat-Packers Sammy Davis, Jr., and Peter Lawford star as London's hippest nightclub owners who take on England's craziest criminals!

programme.title: Anna Lucasta
programme.desc: When wild child Anna Lucasta (Eartha Kitt) is thrown out of the house by her self-righteous father, she falls into the life of prostitution... and into the arms of street-wise sailor Danny Johnson (Sammy Davis, Jr.).

programme.title: Mandela
